tellings.difference: Michels tells it second hand and dates it to the 1950s-1960s. In his telling Vallee "told me the exact same thing", which confirms another source's claim, while the story's telling is Vallee's own suspicion from the 1960s.
tellings.link_reason: Both tellings make the same claim, credited to Jacques Vallee, that Project Blue Book covered for a real secret US Air Force project. This one is Michels passing on what Vallee told him.

as_told.title: Vallee: Blue Book was cover for a real secret project

plain: Jacques Vallee, a French UFO researcher, says that in the 1960s he worked as best he could with Project Blue Book, the US Air Force's public study of UFO reports, while feeling that a real, secret project was running behind it. If true, it would mean the public study was not where the serious work happened. The podcast host Jesse Michels later said Vallee told him the same thing, as backing for another source's claim.
